home.heroSubtitle: ISIKOLO likudibanisa nabafundi abakwilo meko yakho, ezikampini yakho, befunda umxholo ofanayo — ukuze kungabikho buninzi bemibuzo engasombululwanga. Amaphepha adlulileyo, isithethi se-AI, uvimba wemibuzo wosuku, kunye nomhleli wokufunda — konke kwiqonga elinye elakhelwe ngeendlela ezenziwa zixabise kakhulu ukusebenzisa.
home.proofDetail0: Umxholo wesikolo owangenelela kunye nenkxaso epheleleyo yemodyuli ye-NWU kwiindawo eziphakathi.
home.proofDetail1: Yakhelwe ngeendlela zeziseko eziqinileyo kodwa akhutshwe ngokuvulekile — ngoba ukufikelela kwimfundo yekhwalithi akufuneki kuxhomekeke kubungakanani bepokotho yakho.
home.proofDetail2: Isebenza ngedata encinci. Ayinamandla aeefayile, akukho kukhuphela ngokunyanzeliswa.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Amagumbi emodyuli agcina imibuzo isemngciphekweni wesifundo sakho. Izimpendulo ezamkelekileyo zifumana i-credits yeSchola. Ukuthumela ngokungaziwa kuthetha ukuba akudingeki ukoyikela ukuvunduza.
home.step01Body: Buza kwigumbi lemodyuli yakho. Cacisa okanye unamava — umntu kwekampasi yakho unombuzo ofanayo.
home.step02Body: Abafundi abathe babhenela kwizimpendulo bayaphendula. Yenza 'umbuzo ofanayo' ukuze waziswe xa kuphendulwe.
home.step03Body: Phawula impendulo olungileyo kweli yenye. Umphenduli wazo ufumana i-20 yeScholar Credits. Onke amasulukazi aluncedo.
home.featureAskModuleDesc: Thumela umbuzo kwigumbi lemodyuli yakho kwaye ufumana iimpendulo kwizitshomi abathe babenza umngcipheko kuzo. Phawula impendulo eyamkelekileyo kwaye uzuze Scholar Credits.
home.featureAiTutorDesc: Ayiyiyo i-chatbot eqhelekileyo. Buza malunga nemodyuli ethile yakho, ifomati yomvavanyo wecandelo lakho, okanye into efundwe kule veki. Iyazi imeko yakho.
home.featurePastPapersDesc: Amaphepha asemthethweni adlulileyo ngephondo, ibanga, kunye nesifundo. Alikho akhawunti efunekayo yokukhangela. Eyona SA ipheleleyo yepeppa ebalini yefayile ekwi-intanethi.
home.featureDailyQuizDesc: Umibuzo ohamba-hamba ngosuku kubanjwe. Yamazikileyo iindawo zobuthathaka kwaye ikuthumele imibuzo endiza kuyilungisa. Gcina uqhelaniso lwakho luphila kwaye ukhwele kwimigangatho yeenkozo.
home.featurePlannerDesc: Yakhezeka ngokweCAPS kubafundi besikolo. Ukwenza ngokukhuphela kwabafundi bekholiji. Ishedyuli yakho, yahlalathiwe malunga noko okuhamba kakuhle.
home.featureGamesDesc: BRAZIL, umdlalo we-adventure wokuphila komfundi, uyaphila ngoku. Uvavanyo lwe-Exam Dash — umbuzo we-MCQ nge-Scholar Credits — sele igqityiwe. Imidlalo emininzi iza nokuza.
home.whySchoolSubtitle: Yakhelwe umfundi wamaZwe Zimbi — hayi iqonga elitsha elijolise kumxholo wendawo.
home.trustCopy0: Ibanga R ukuya lungisa. Ubungozi obupheleleyo obuqhelekileyo kubafundi besikolo kunye nenkxaso epheleleyo ye-modyuli ye-NWU ngenye ukufaka.
home.trustCopy1: Ukubonelela ngokufaneleka. Imibandela ye-Data-light for SA connections. Akukho khadi letyala, akukhoe-fayela, akukho imveliso yokukhuphela — naxabiso lesehlukana kwi-platform esi isithwa.
home.trustCopy2: Uluntu, isithethi se-AI, amaphepha adlulileyo, uvimba wemibuzo wosuku, isicwangciso sokufunda, nemidlalo — konke phantsi komthetho omnye.
home.trustCopy3: Ngqo kwaye lifudumele. Akukho-mlingelane e-biznis ibalele, akukho miahla yemfuno. ISIKOLO lithetha oko lithetha lona.
home.liveAnchorLastAdded: Iphepha lokugqibela elongeziweyo {relativeDate}. Ulphiwe igrowa ngamandla.
home.liveAnchorFeaturesBody: Unomdla onokwazani mayowa platform? Jonga isakhiwo esisinyaniso — yonke into yeso- platform.
home.missionHeading: Yakhelwe wonke amaZwe Zimbi. Yonke iperimizi ukuba akekho ndiluhlanga.
home.missionPara1: I ISIKOLO eyayenziwa yi-Moloti Ditshego ngenjongo elingecalco lomfundi ogqanyiweyo, kodwa njengalefofu yokwenziwa uthamileyo lwezenzululwazi, iziphilosofi, nemfundiso emdala esebenza ngefuthe lethemba elidinga kobayini abamnyama aba-Nazwes Zimbi, ngaphandle kokuqhuba ukufundwa kwe-rac.
home.missionPara2: Uqwalaselo olulwe sizoshishini ebekufakemali kuyilo leplatform ngalo — bebonke bephak'ephule bencinamba. Kutsho ngezona-agezndoda epsezongkqubo lazo sengathi-gqunda namahasi ngokuwa kweengelosi.
home.missionPara3Pre: Moloti chola okwaziwa ngathi-Ingozi-phela, iqondo loMthetho
home.missionPara3Post: — Ingqelelo yomdlalo wephazili: ukhesisiphumelelo esingaphaya kwesilumkisini kwayo kuwe sikhemiswa kalokuthi kwakwi inxulumini zemidlalo. ISIKOLO ineshishini yokufumana isixhosa kuluntu, nasimntu agxondoro abanjolu ijiza eliphumeziwe.
home.missionPara4: I-Ditshego Ventures ibulela bonke abazisebenze apha kweli qokolo. Amaxa okuvuma aziyi nikwa iimposiso — ngokusemthethweni, kahle ngendlela enenelezanga kuba ukufuna.
home.socialSubtitle: Fumanani imithunzana ephuhlileyo, iindaba zamakampasi, kunye nezihloko zoluntu kwiphepha lethu elisemthethweni.
